cases.name: a printer on device 4 at start shows the Printer icon (KERNAL OPEN and CHKOUT on file 121)
a row dropped on the Printer icon is printed as stored after Print is chosen
several rows print in listing order after one question; Cancel prints nothing
a Paint picture dropped on the Printer icon prints in bit-image bands whose dots are exactly its bitmap pixels, then CHR$(15)
a picture that ends early prints the bands its rows cover, returns the printer to text mode and says printing stopped
a printer that no longer answers is reported and every file is closed
a USB text file prints with ASCII letters as PETSCII and CR, LF, CR LF as CR
